S0128.reason: Holdover plus accepted monthly rent created a month-to-month tenancy, which one month’s written notice ends; FMV matching, good cause, and the old default reentry clause do not control.

S0677.reason: Passive personality jurisdiction rests on the victim’s nationality; the offender’s nationality is active personality and the place of the act is territorial.

S0669.reason: A stronger second shock can still fire the cell only in the relative refractory period, which corresponds to afterhyperpolarization, not the absolute refractory depolarization or early repolarization.
